user.title: Loan
user.description: A loan tied to Euribor. When a new interest period begins, the rate is set to the Euribor of the reset day.

data_description.name: The loan gets a device of this name, with sensors for its rate, the Euribor it is locked to, the rate at the newest Euribor and the next reset.
data_description.maturity: The Euribor the loan follows. A 12 month loan is reset once a year, a 3 month one four times a year, and so on.
data_description.margin: The bank's margin, added to Euribor.
data_description.start_date: The day the loan was drawn down. The rate is reset by it, and the chart shows the loan's rates from it on.
data_description.lock_days: How many banking days before the reset day the bank locks the Euribor, as the loan's terms say. 0 uses the reset day's own rate.
